journey: Escalation cannot misreference a foreign job

narrative.step: tenant A runs a real job (the id genuinely exists)
positive control: tenant A CAN read its own job for escalation (200 held)
narrative.assertion: owner reads it: 200 held (id is real + live)

narrative.step: tenant B pastes A's lease_id into an escalation → GET resolves to 404 (no oracle)
narrative.assertion: foreign lease_id → 404 (must be 404 — an escalation can't reference another tenant's job)
